mappingPolicy: Only topologically determined mappings (counter boundary <-> counter contour) are 'mapped'. Positive-mass components are 'provisional-unmapped': candidateRefs are reviewable proposals with a stated geometric basis, not facts. Source path order is not evidence of stroke order.

components.name: aperture-boundary
components.basis: Not mapped: the aperture is not yet classified (AUD-01). No boundary is synthesised.

apertureInterpretation.intendedIdentity: Exterior-connected opening that distinguishes G from C and O (identity profile: apertureCount 1).
observations: Single closed outer contour; legacy hole array is empty.

Observed (unreviewed): the unfilled interior bounded by the inner wall (outer#15), inner top (outer#16/#17) and the bar (outer#09) meets the outside on the right, between the upper terminal end cap (outer#19) and the bar top edge (outer#09).

Proven by the T04 geometry validator (GEO_UNFILLED_SPACE_EXTERIOR_CONNECTED): the single outer contour is simple and there are no inner contours, so all unfilled space is exterior-connected. This does not define the aperture boundary or its width.
blockers: aperture-boundary component has no reviewed geometry mapping.
Measurement construction for apertureWidth is undefined (AUD-03).
